notes: *Thou hast asked a hard thing*: the ASV made the infinitive its English finite verb, so *Thou hast asked* stays with sha'ol and the hiphil qashah takes the recast object *a hard thing*; giving *Thou hast* to the 2ms finite verb under rule 17 is the competing reading and is defensible. Second *so* and *when* answer to no morpheme and are `added`.
